title: Bromley Emergency Help Points
summary: Hospital emergency services, walk-in care centres, environmental hazard notes, and supply corridors in Bromley.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Princess Royal University Hospital (PRUH): Farnborough Common, Orpington BR6 8ND. From Bromley South station: take bus 61, 261, or 358 south along Masons Hill and Hastings Road (~20 mins), or drive ~3.5 miles south.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Beckenham Beacon Urgent Treatment Centre: 379 Croydon Road, Beckenham BR3 3QL. From Beckenham Junction station: ~15 min walk south-west along Croydon Road (~0.8 miles), or take bus 54 or 352 (~6 mins).
- Queen Mary's Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Frognal Avenue, Sidcup DA14 6LT (accessible for north-east Bromley). From Chislehurst War Memorial: take bus 269 north-east (~15 mins).

3. Local Hazards
- Surface water and river flood risks along the River Ravensbourne headwaters, River Pool, and River Kyd catchments in central Bromley and Beckenham.
- Steep terrain and wooded single-lane roads around Biggin Hill and Cudham prone to storm debris blockages and severe surface runoff.

4. Essential Supplies
- Major supermarkets and dispensing pharmacies located on Bromley High Street, Beckenham High Street, and Orpington High Street stock potable water, first-aid goods, and over-the-counter medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
